purpose: MERN Lead Management System: admin JWT login, agent management, CSV/XLSX lead upload and equal distribution of leads across agents. React 18 (create-react-app) frontend in frontend/, Express + Mongoose backend in backend/.
guidance: Preserve the Express/Mongoose backend and the React frontend. The backend has no test runner configured, so write tests with Node's built-in test runner (node:test and node:assert, file name *.test.js under backend/tests/) and only test code that can be imported without connecting to MongoDB or the network (extract a small pure helper into the route/middleware file if needed, and test that). Do not add dependencies. Never read, print or rely on real values of backend/.env. Frontend changes are verified by the CRA build only, so keep them small and type-safe.
focus_areas: lead upload parsing and validation (CSV/XLSX headers, empty rows, file type checks)
lead distribution among agents (uneven counts, zero rows, remainders)
agent management validation (email format, duplicate handling, response shape)
authentication and authorization (token parsing, missing secrets, role checks)
backend error handling and consistent API error responses
React component improvements (loading/error states, form validation)
